decision.summary: The Fed lowered the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to a range of 4 to 4-1/4 percent.

changes.quote: Job gains have slowed, and the unemployment rate has edged up but remains low.
changes.explanation: The Fed added this language to acknowledge cooling in the labor market.

changes.quote: Inflation has moved up and remains somewhat elevated.
changes.explanation: The Fed updated its description of inflation to note it has ticked upward.

changes.quote: The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate and judges that downside risks to employment have risen.
changes.explanation: The Fed noted that threats to maximum employment have increased relative to inflation.

changes.quote: In support of its goals and in light of the shift in the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4 to 4-1/4 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed officially reduced its benchmark interest rate due to the changing economic balance.

tone_quotes.quote: Job gains have slowed, and the unemployment rate has edged up but remains low.
The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate and judges that downside risks to employment have risen.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 21.16% APR, a 25 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.06% and moved +2 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.5% would rise by about $3.95 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 4.3%, and employers added an average of -9k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.9% over the past year (August 2025); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.9%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 4% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +1 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -0.1%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.02% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that policymakers will continue reviewing incoming data and economic conditions before making further changes to interest rates.
